summary: Enhance your skills with our Accounting for Governmental and Nonprofit Entities Training Course. Learn essential practices to excel in public sector finance.
lede: Government and nonprofit accounting training covers tracking public and donor funds and preparing financial reports that show how resources are managed. Designed for accountants, finance staff, and auditors, it builds practical skills in fund accounting and encumbrance tracking, reconciling fund records into entity-wide statements, and preparing nonprofit activity and functional expense reports.
audienceIntro: This course targets professionals who prepare or audit financial reports for governments and nonprofits.
modules: Governmental Accounting Frameworks and GASB Standards
Fund Accounting Applications and Encumbrance Tracking
Nonprofit Financial Reporting under FASB Standards
Budget Integration and Internal Control Design
Single Audit and Federal Compliance Requirements
Digital Tools and Data Analytics in Public Accounting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic accrual accounting and prior exposure to fund accounting concepts or public sector financial statements is required. No programming or coding skills are needed.
